deadline.value: There is no formal deadline. Applications complete by early February have the best chance for Fall.
deadline.quote: There is no formal deadline for receipt of applications | candidates for Fall whose applications are complete by early February will have the best chance of success

app_fee.value: International applicants pay a $75 application fee.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, though scores may be sent.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required but students may have it submitted to the University by ETS

gre_subject.value: GRE requirement stated on program page.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is not required but students may have it submitted to the University by ETS

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 or above meets the English requirement.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL IBT equal to 80 or above

ielts_min.value: IELTS 6.5 or above meets the English requirement.

funding.value: Applicants are considered for assistantships while positions remain. The page does not say how many PhD students are funded.
funding.quote: All applicants for admission to the M.S. or Ph.D. programs will automatically be considered | for financial support

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty sponsor is needed to be admitted.

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's need 90 graduate credit hours. Applicants with a master's need 60.
entry_route.quote: A minimum of 90 hours of graduate credit must be completed; 60 hours if the student holds a master

notes: Doctorate covers pure math, applied math and statistics concentrations. Requirements text is from the older catalog quoted on the PhD page. The Mathematics English list also includes Duolingo 105 and PTE 58, which the graduate school lists differently (Duolingo 110).
